feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Cloudy and dry to start this evening, then cloud thickening with rain arriving before midnight, this falling as snow over the hills. Fresh to strong southeast wind continuing to increase to gale force, especially over high ground.

Rain through the night, turning heavy at times with a risk of surface water flooding, especially in the west, and initially falling as snow on hills, above about 1000 feet. Blizzards for a time on highest parts, but turning to rain towards or around dawn. Rain the turning patchier by the afternoon.

Gale force east or southeast winds may touch severe gale force through early hours to lee of hills around parts of west with gusts of 60mph, before then steadily easing through day and veering southwest. Top temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

Generally cloudy with outbreaks of rain at times. Moderate to fresh northeast winds strengthening later. Top temperature 9°C.
